backends.device: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 4060 (sm_89, 8.2 GB, 24 SMs, 25 MB L2)

reasons.decode_attention: unmeasured on sm_89; highest-priority available backend
reasons.prefill_attention: unmeasured on sm_89; highest-priority available backend
reasons.measure: run `ab.py --setting decode_kernel` and `--setting prefill_kernel` on this device, then add the winners to MEASURED

decode_backends.name: flash
decode_backends.reason: flash_attn is not installed (pip install flash-attn, sm_80+ wheels)
decode_backends.summary: flash_attn_with_kvcache over the pages; splits internally, GQA native.

decode_backends.name: gqa
decode_backends.summary: Triton, one program per (row, KV head), K/V tile shared by the group. Measured 0.95-1.06x on the T4: L2 already serves the second read.

decode_backends.name: per_head
decode_backends.summary: Triton, one program per (row, query head); the measured baseline.

decode_backends.name: split_k
decode_backends.summary: Triton FlashDecoding: the key range split across programs, then merged. For small batches and long contexts, where the per-head grid is too narrow.

prefill_backends.name: flash
prefill_backends.reason: flash_attn is not installed (pip install flash-attn, sm_80+ wheels)
prefill_backends.summary: flash_attn_with_kvcache with causal=True over the pages: no gather, no mask.

prefill_backends.name: per_token
prefill_backends.summary: Triton, one program per (row, head, query token), reads pages in place. The only chunked path that works with an INT8 pool.

prefill_backends.name: sdpa
prefill_backends.summary: Gather the prefix pages, then torch SDPA (memory-efficient backend). The T4 default: -40%/-66% step vs per_token, token-identical to stock.

prefill_backends.name: tiled
prefill_backends.summary: Triton FlashAttention structure with tl.dot over paged K/V. Needs sm_80+ to reach the tensor cores; an explicit candidate gated by prefill_attention_ab.py --ptx-only and the RTX A/B.
